details.publicNotes:
Unlike most daemons, which represent deaths from clear physical causes, lethodaemons represent the creeping death of the self through memory loss. Stealthy enough to sneak into most places unseen, lethodaemons are intelligent enough to target those who society already expects to be forgetful anyway, such as the elderly or the kind of absentminded people who constantly misplace items. Known liars and the corrupt are also enjoyable targets, as few will actually believe their protestations that they have truly forgotten whatever it was they did wrong.

After creating holes in a victim's memory, lethodaemons enjoy filling the gaps with false recollections that encourage their victim toward paranoia and suspicion of the others around them. Though they typically prefer subtle corruption, lethodaemons also enjoy opportunities to inflict more brutal mind-scrambling, confounding a target completely until they can no longer tell friend from foe, lashing out indiscriminately at the world around them out of anger and confusion.

Lethodaemons sometimes serve more powerful daemons, interfering as spies and saboteurs to undermine any efforts to oppose their overlord's corruption. In the rare case where they are caught in the act, a quick manipulation of the offending party's memories is typically enough to ensure the lethodaemon's escape. When that's not sufficient, the lethodaemon either takes to the sky in flight or stands their ground against opponents capable of outpacing them or shooting them out of the air.

Riddle Me This

While lethodaemons can wipe out a person's memories, there's one thing they can't erase: the memory of the daemon's own words, either spoken or telepathic. However, they can rewrite a memory to place their words—which frequently contain mocking riddles—into the mouth of someone else. Not infrequently, these clues lead to the lethodaemon's own unmasking.

Monster Parts 375/840/1,560 gp

description.value:
You scramble a creature's mental faculties and sensory input. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result of that save, the target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes. Warp mind's effects happen instantly, so @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} and other effects that counteract spells can't counteract them. However, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} rituals and abilities that can remove non-magical effects can still counteract the effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target spends the first action on its next turn with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Confused permanently.

You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through effects that target curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as –5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.

You cause the target to see all other creatures as dire threats. The target is stricken by intense paranoia toward all creatures around it and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally. The spell ends after 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

You alter the target's memories by erasing a memory, enhancing a memory's clarity, altering a memory, or adding a false memory. The target can attempt a Will save to resist the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of rewrite memory, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure During the first 5 minutes of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to modify a memory once each round. When you do, you imagine up to 6 seconds of memory to modify, to a maximum of 5 continuous minutes of memory.

Any memories you've altered remain changed as long as the spell is active. If the target moves out of range before the 5 minutes is up, you can't alter any further memories.

Heightened (6th) You can Cast the Spell on a willing target to suppress all memory of a particular topic, detailed in 50 words or fewer. The effect is permanent, and it patches these omissions with an indistinct haze.

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

You alter the target's memories by erasing a memory, enhancing a memory's clarity, altering a memory, or adding a false memory. The target can attempt a Will save to resist the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of rewrite memory, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure During the first 5 minutes of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to modify a memory once each round. When you do, you imagine up to 6 seconds of memory to modify, to a maximum of 5 continuous minutes of memory.

Any memories you've altered remain changed as long as the spell is active. If the target moves out of range before the 5 minutes is up, you can't alter any further memories.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

The lethodaemon senses all non-mindless creatures at the listed range. When a lethodaemon detects a creature with thoughtsense, they also determine if the creature's memories have been magically modified, whether by the lethodaemon or another creature. If the other creature was attempting to be subtle about their manipulation, the lethodaemon must succeed at a Perception check against the DC of the memory-altering ability in order to detect it.

description.value: The lethodaemon rips away their victim's memories, leaving small gaps that disorient it. When a lethodaemon damages a creature with a melee Strike, the creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:33] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. Further exposures to Drain Memory increase the stupefied condition's value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}. The stupefied value reduces by 1 every hour.

Frequency once per minute

Effect The lethodaemon calls upon the forgetful mists of the River Styx, gaining a 30-foot aura that clouds the minds of creatures within it for 3 rounds. All creatures that start their turn in the aura must attempt a Will save against Drain Memory. The mists are transparent to creatures whose minds are clear, but murky to those whose minds are clouded. All creatures within the aura become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to stupefied creatures, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to stupefied creatures within it.
